title: Snapshot
description: What a subject looked like at one moment. Append-only: snapshots are never overwritten, so the system can always answer 'what did this look like six months ago?' and 'what changed?'. Stored as JSONL, one snapshot per line.

raw_capture_path.description: Path under data/raw/ holding the unmodified retrieved content, if retained.

state.description: The observed state of the subject at capture time. Shape is defined by the subject's own schema.

content_hash.description: Hash of the normalised state, used to detect no-change captures cheaply.

changed.description: Whether this capture differs from the previous one. Derived, not asserted.
